meta.note: Built from the apple-web-design skill (now fly-ui), a guidelines-only skill: no CSS variables, fonts, marks or components. Values below were chosen to follow its rules (system font stack, semantic tokens, restrained accent, glass for chrome only, motion defaults copied from motion-guidelines.md).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Background layer: the page behind content surfaces and chrome. Never put long text directly on a busy background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content layer: cards, article bodies, tables, forms. Stable and opaque, never glass.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets that sit above content. Pair with a shadow token in light, with the lighter fill in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields, segmented-control tracks, switch tracks when off, code blocks.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash on plain buttons, list rows and toolbar items. Laid over any surface.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `glass` in both themes.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, captions, toolbar subtitles. Readable (4.5:1+) on `background`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text only, never information a person needs to read.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, card edges, toolbar bottom edge. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (text field, switch off-state outline in high contrast). 3:1 on `surface` and `background`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Graphite accent. Primary button fill, switch on-state, selected segment indicator, links. Once per view for the main action.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a primary button on pointer devices.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill. Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px gap. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Control/chrome layer only: toolbars, search bars, floating actions, menus. Always with `blur-glass` and the `glass-solid` fallback.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for `glass` when backdrop-filter is unsupported or prefers-reduced-transparency is on.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Inner edge that keeps a glass control readable against content scrolling beneath it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a modal sheet.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status text and icons on `surface` and `info-soft`. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an informational badge or banner; text on it is `info`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status text and icons on `surface` and `success-soft`. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success badge or banner; text on it is `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status text and icons on `surface` and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning badge or banner; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text on `surface` and `danger-soft`; text-field error border.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error badge or banner; text on it is `danger`.

families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per page: the page title.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, emphasised labels, toolbar title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 内容优先：正文保持稳定、易读，不放在玻璃材质上。
styles.usage: Long-form reading text, max width `content-width`. Line height tuned for Chinese.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: 按钮、输入框与表格中的默认文字
styles.usage: Default UI text: buttons, inputs, table cells, dense dashboards.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Field labels, segmented controls, tab labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: 最后更新于 3 分钟前
styles.usage: Hints, helper and error text under fields, metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges and the smallest labels. Never thinner than 400.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, code, logs. Let blocks scroll horizontally rather than wrap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls in a toolbar or button group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (sm), list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (md), page gutter on phones, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on compact layouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a page's large title, between major regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, menus items, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, toolbars that float.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and modal dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: switches, capsule toolbars, avatar circles.

shadow.note: Shadows separate floating chrome from content. Content cards use a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards that need lift off `background`, switch knobs.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating toolbars, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and modal dialogs.

layout.note: Reading measure from the skill: 680–760px for long text.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of article bodies and long forms.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Max width of dashboards and app pages.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the glass toolbar.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and segmented controls in dense toolbars.

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons; the minimum touch target on phones.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for `glass` chrome. Keep it modest for Safari and mobile performance.

duration.note: From the skill's motion guidelines: routine UI motion stays under 300ms; frequent keyboard actions get none.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale 0.97) on buttons.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and toggle transitions; tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, segmented indicator.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and drawers.

tokens.name: ease-out-ui
tokens.usage: Entering and exiting UI; responds immediately.

tokens.name: ease-in-out-ui
tokens.usage: Movement between two visible positions (segment indicator).

tokens.name: ease-drawer-ui
tokens.usage: Sheets and drawers.
